Best Denki Tampines 1 Grand Opening Sale: Unbeatable deals, up to $30,000 gachapon prizes, and more

Expect wagon sale deals from $1, one-day-only Daily Super Deals, store-exclusive pricing and more.

By Team HardwareZone - 3 Nov 2026

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 8:41
Instaread

After nearly a decade away, Best Denki is returning to Tampines with a brand-new outlet at Tampines 1. To celebrate their comeback with a bang, Best Denki is holding a Grand Opening Sale from 6 to 9 November 2026.

Shoppers can expect deep discounts on selected items, time-limited specials, daily lucky draws and a sure-win gachapon game. Munch on the free snacks as you browse the deals and collect a free welcome pack (worth $35, limited to 100 redemptions daily).

To redeem the welcome pack, present the promotional flyer distributed to nearby residential estates or handed out at the store. Whether you’re a Tampines resident or not, all are welcome to drop by. Here is a complete rundown of what’s happening during the four-day event.

  1. 1. Overview: Best Denki Tampines 1 store opening
  2. 2. Score deep discounts on select electronics and appliances 
  3. 3. Grab time-limited daily specials before they run out
  4. 4. Win at the Bonus Draw, over $30,000 in gachapon prizes up for grabs
  5. 5. Stack credit card and payment promotions to save even more
  6. 6. Best Denki Tampines 1 Grand Opening Sale

Overview: Best Denki Tampines 1 store opening

Remember when Century Square closed in September 2017 for a year of renovations? Anchor tenants like Best Denki had to move out to accommodate the shopping mall’s major revamp. Nine years later, the electronics retailer has finally found its way back to the neighbourhood, with a new outlet at Tampines 1.

The Best Denki Tampines 1 store takes over Gain City’s former space at #B1-10/11/12. To celebrate, they are holding a four-day Grand Opening Sale from 6 to 9 November 2026, with extended store hours from 10am to 10pm.

To fuel you as you shop, Best Denki is giving away free ice pops, coffee, and slushies. Shoppers who have completed their purchase can redeem complimentary donuts and a traditional ice cream. Just be careful not to keep the snacks clear of the merchandise while you browse!

Score deep discounts on select electronics and appliances 

When it comes to pricing for electronics, gadgets, and home and kitchen appliances, here’s what to look forward to at the Grand Opening Sale:

  • Promotional discounts of up to 88% off
  • Wagon Sale bargains for tech gadgets and accessories priced from $1
  • Additional store opening discounts of up to $1,000 off (with minimum spend)
  • Extra 11% off on selected kitchen appliances and beauty care

Here is a sneak preview of some of the top steals, with many more deals waiting for you at the one-stop shop. Do note that many of these deals have limited stock available.

Grab time-limited daily specials before they run out

There will be various Daily Super Deals that go up to 88% off, with limited stock available. Plenty of in-store deals will be available on a wide range of products. Found it cheaper elsewhere? Best Denki will match the price if you’re a member. Here are some of the highlights:

  • Day 1 (6 November 2026): Tiger 480ml Vacuum Insulated Bottle (86% off) and Lenovo Ideapad Slim 3 (38% off)
  • Day 2 (7 November 2026): Samsung A07 LTE Smartphone (62% off)
  • Day 3 (8 November 2026): LG 65-inch 4K LED AI TV (44% off)
  • Day 4 (9 November 2026): Tefal Rice Cooker (85% off) and JisuLife Handheld Fan Life 9 (72% off)

Win at the Bonus Draw, over $30,000 in gachapon prizes up for grabs

Spend $50 in a single receipt for a chance to participate in their ‘sure-win’ gachapon, with the top prize being a Dyson Airstrait (worth $799). With the same $50 receipt, you’ll also qualify for the Bonus Draw and have a shot at taking home prizes such as an Asus Zenbook laptop (worth $3,499), ASUS Vivobook, and Acer Iconia Tablet. Simply scan the in-store QR code to enter the Bonus Draw.

Furthermore, buying anything at Best Denki Tampines 1 gives you a chance to enter The Grand Electrical Fair 26/27’s lucky draw so you get more shots at walking away with extra rewards.

Related: Best Denki The Grand Electrical Fair 26/27: Get huge discounts, win lucky draw prizes, and more

Stack credit card and payment promotions to save even more

Those paying off a big purchase via an instalment plan can do so with a DBS/POSB credit card to get $80 off (with a minimum $2,500 charge on a 12-month instalment payment plan). Or use PayLater by Grab for up to $150 off (with an 8-month or 12-month instalment plan).

Other promotions include BEST-OCBC cardholders getting an additional 3% cash rebate or using SPayLater to get up to $50 off (with minimum spend).

All prices and deals are correct at time of publication. For more information, please speak directly with the staff at your nearest Best Denki outlet.

Best Denki Tampines 1 Grand Opening Sale

If you’re hitting up the Grand Opening Sale, make sure to register for a free Best Denki membership first.

You’ll get a free spin on the rewards wheel and stand a chance to win up to 60,000 Best Denki points (equivalent to $600 that can be used to offset future in-store purchases). Download the Best Denki app to track your transaction history and rack up points when you shop.

Between the store-exclusive bargains and lucky draw prizes to be won, there are plenty of reasons to swing by and check out the Best Denki Tampines 1 Grand Opening Sale.

Date: 6 to 9 November 2026
Opening hours: 10am to 10pm (during the Grand Opening Sale)
Location: 10 Tampines Central 1, Tampines 1, #B1-10/11/12, Singapore 529536
